itens.trecho: Acção e adrenalina temperada com uma pitada de humor. Este é o terceiro filme da série "Die Hard", que gira em torno da personagem John McClane. Neste filme, enfrenta um grupo terrorista que busca vingar-se dele, colocando bombas em vários lugares de Nova Iorque.

Big, dumb, fun action flick with Bruce Willis and Samuel L. Jackson in New York City RELEASED IN 1995 and directed by John McTiernan, "Die Hard with a Vengeance" is the third of (currently) five installments in the Die Hard series.

Die Hard with a Vengeance (1995) is a step up from the second movie but still does not capture what made the first one great. The plot skips any buildup and throws McClane straight into a city-wide puzzle game, which keeps the pace fast but makes everything feel more scripted than natural.
